news.text: The Concord reached 100 soldiers first (100 against 94) and took Verdel Ridge. The deciding rifle belonged to @jro_se11. For 3 days the guns on the heights will pound the Hegemony lines, and for 7 days the high ground keeps the Concord safer. The race for Hill 304 begins now.

blocks.text: @ghai.gpt (Concord sniper) badly wounded @0__freddie__0. @csllgaks (Concord machine gunner) grazed @wolfmanantony. @leo.glc (Concord stretcher bearer) grazed @slightlyretarded69.
Hegemony: aid post 1/2 beds, 0/6 stretchers, medics covering 100% of the wounded. Concord: aid post 0/2 beds, 0/6 stretchers, medics covering 100% of the wounded.
Clear weather exposed paths usually hidden by haze. Carrying parties waited for darkness rather than risk the open stretches.

115 new soldiers came up the line. Hegemony: @lorenzo_sapino_, @fransinlak, @acakostic11, @austintress, @deadeyesimulacrum, @matteozrybak, @galvanooooo, @carlingiti and 45 more. Concord: @pbscn_, @jiri.satalik, @topekeno, @yee.zle, @knightowlvt, @v01py, @vuminhtri260709, @spencerbonthoux and 54 more.

items: At the Weeping Orchard, Albin Chloe of the Hegemony and Edmund "Whistle" Es of the Concord fired at the same loose sheet of metal. The wind kept winning. (@chloe.g.t, @es31230)

Yann Vee (Concord) and Silas Zdsh (Hegemony) met in the same shell hole at Calvary Farm during a raid. They stared at each other. Then each crawled home, and neither has told anyone. (@ask._.vee, @reza_zdsh)
Edmund "Hollow" Biwott of the Concord threw a tin of tobacco into the Hegemony trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal kept the tin. (@hodnepijumaloctu, @a_k_biwott)
For keeping his head when others lost theirs at the Chalk Pits, Nils "Hollow" Jozifanderso was promoted to Lance Corporal. (@jozifanderson)
Konrad Jngaf repaired the strap on Jakub Ebrrrvole's pack. Payment was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut. (@gremlin_jngaf, @ebrrrvole)

blocks.text: Hegemony 57/100 · Concord 63/100. The Concord lead by 6. 37 more and the heights are theirs.
Wounded: @0__freddie__0. Strength on the line: Hegemony 57 · Concord 63.
@mng.ngaihte (Hegemony machine gunner) grazed @steini10.02. @gaita_4119 (Hegemony sniper) badly wounded @yoi.photo. @hellcat34106 (Hegemony machine gunner) grazed @jakubwilkuu.
Hegemony: hospital 1/4 beds, 0/10 stretchers, medics covering 100% of the wounded. Concord: hospital 1/4 beds, 0/10 stretchers, medics covering 100% of the wounded.
Lightning revealed the ground in sudden fragments. Between flashes, the dark seemed thicker than before.

46 new soldiers came up the line. Hegemony: @arch_izu, @shadowizard__, @allistofearisgod, @gaita_4119, @josiascouper, @brunoescobar36, @trey15jameson, @rylan_45h and 17 more. Concord: @hawkenram, @johnrant21, @frank_mart00, @le.mrsh_, @alexanderbathfalamorthethird, @hansaazz, @eccentricredeye, @max.kattawar and 13 more.

What does your side build? The Hegemony chose HOSPITAL (17 to 11). The Concord chose HOSPITAL (25 to 7). The Hegemony dug a deep hospital dugout behind the reserve line, out of rifle range: 4 beds. The Concord dug a deep hospital dugout behind the reserve line, out of rifle range: 4 beds.

items: At Calvary Farm, Teodor Acakostic of the Hegemony and Yann Vee of the Concord traded insults across the wire for an hour. By the end they were trading recipes. (@acakostic11, @ask._.vee)
Felix Szymanski of the Hegemony threw a tin of tobacco into the Concord trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Isidor Jackmdunn kept the tin. (@jackmdunn06, @franek.szymanski.376)

During a lull at Sorrow Copse, Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac called across from the Concord line. Roland Monster answered from the Hegemony side with a convincing imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet. (@samhatespeace, @gunpla_monster)
A football came over the parapet from the Concord side with Anselm "Parson" Rock's name scratched on it. Gustav "Tin" Jul kicked it back. It did not come again. (@vic_jul11, @rotrek_rock)

On a quiet night Marek Ham (Concord) and Edmund Matteozrybak (Hegemony) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there. (@rals.ham, @matteozrybak)

blocks.text: Hegemony 82/100 · Concord 84/100. The Concord lead by 2. 16 more and the heights are theirs.
Wounded: @yoi.photo. Missing: @hanka_b97 and @chloe.g.t. Strength on the line: Hegemony 82 · Concord 84.
